page.layout: One leaf of manuscript with no printed text. Handwritten ownership inscription at the top, a ruled line, a second handwritten line below it, and a hand-drawn diagram of concentric curves crossed by a grid.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The upper and middle lines are handwritten (an ownership inscription with "Anno Domini" and a date that looks like 1620), and the lower diagram is a hand-drawn figure of concentric curves with a grid, not print. Handwriting and drawings are excluded from the transcription. Ink show-through and paper stains are also visible and are not transcribed.
